native_preview_comparison.method: Read-only per-cell native alpha compositing over exporter charcoal after nearest3x scale, compared exactRGBAbytes to original preview sprite rectangle. No raster files written.

animation_order: Frame-major: four S, N, E, W facings per frame.
color_and_identity_constraints: Ochre/yellow-olive skin and broad short body; this species is warmer/yellower than the greener Goblin.
Large high triangular upright ears with reddish-brown inner material and darkbrown outer rim; preserve sharply pointed ear silhouette rather than Goblin rounded/laterally broad ears.
Bright yellow awake eyes and tiny light teeth; short squared muzzle/face. No invented tail,hair,horns,clothes,armor or Goblin replacement.
Match approved polished pixel/voxel shading while keeping Kobold identity, S/N/E/W direction order, body proportions and native limb-state identity.
Use small source red stump caps, not enlarged gore. Missing arms means no hands or forearms; missing legs means no feet or boots; None is head and torso only.
notes: Default state is Normal, not an unnamed/blank state.
Kobold has 18 states rather than Goblin 17. Sneak adds 12 fully transparent native frames, with no padding or omitted preview frames.
Combination-state row ordering differs from Goblins: follow this source state order exactly.
Sleep frame 1 has dim ochre/olive eye areas; Sleep frame 2 is a standalone Z graphic.
Page 1 includes one 12-cell Normal animation state plus two Sleep frames. Pages 2–4 have one 12-cell limb-animation state each. Pages 5–7 have four static states each.

Page 8 records the 12 intentionally empty Sneak cells. Do not generate visible sprites for that state. Runtime metadata and transparency preservation are still required when converting to game assets.
This file is read-only production planning. No artwork generated, source files changed or shared manifest edited.
